write_up: Your Army experience makes a strong case for operations supervision: you lead maintenance, supply and fuel teams, manage equipment, and improve vehicle readiness. This resume gives a recruiter the numbers behind that work instead of leaving them to guess!

The vehicle readiness line is your best model. It shows the starting point, the improvement and the changes you made to get there. Your target job is named up front, and your civilian supply chain degree and Green Belt reinforce the direction.

Start by naming the logistics support you provided during the field exercises, then add what you taught the junior mechanics. Your resume isn't the main obstacle to a callback; the fit and competition for each operations role matter too.
